name: Han Kai
source:
「I, too, have to become stronger to protect Nee-san.」

She is the shock troop commander of [url=https://vndb.org/c136825]Ryuu Hou[/url]'s army. A big sister who enjoys pampering.

She's Ryuu Hou's childhood friend and younger sister. She likes everyone in Ryuu Hou's army, who can smile even after many defeats, and Ryuu Hou, who can make everyone smile happily.

Individually, she is as strong as [url=https://vndb.org/c136820]Kou U[/url], and she continues to support the weak Ryuu Hou's army by herself.

She is at first apprehensive of [url=https://vndb.org/c136830]Shiba Sen[/url] as a suspicious person approaching Ryuu Hou, but after trusting him with her true name, she gradually begins to coddle him and treat him overly protectively.
